# Bodies in Motion

> Licensed childcare, preschool, camps, and family activities in Boise, Idaho (one location: 729 W. Diamond St).

Bodies in Motion (bodiesinmotionidaho.com) is an Idaho STARS provider serving Boise, Meridian, and Garden City families since 2011. Childcare is the primary program; camps, open play, parties, and sports activities share the same facility.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://bodiesinmotionidaho.com/): childcare, preschool, after-school overview
- [Infant & Toddler Care](https://bodiesinmotionidaho.com/infant-toddler-care): ages 6 weeks–3 years
- [Preschool](https://bodiesinmotionidaho.com/preschool): ages 3–6
- [Before & After School Care](https://bodiesinmotionidaho.com/after-school-care): K–6th grade
- [Camps](https://bodiesinmotionidaho.com/camps): summer, no-school, and holiday camps (register via Camps for Kids Idaho)
- [Parents' Night Out](https://bodiesinmotionidaho.com/parents-night-out): evening drop-off events
- [Open Play](https://bodiesinmotionidaho.com/open-play): indoor playground hours and specials
- [Birthday Parties](https://bodiesinmotionidaho.com/birthday-parties)
- [Contact](https://bodiesinmotionidaho.com/contact): (208) 381-0587 · help@bodiesinmotionidaho.com
- [Hours](https://bodiesinmotionidaho.com/hours)
- [About](https://bodiesinmotionidaho.com/about)
